results.title: attach a file
results.catalogRow: §5 promptForm declared — both halves or unsupported (DECLARED on all four)

control.what: a plain send on this same session having already produced a reply (probe 1)
control.detail: probe 1 PASSED here, so this session can send and answer

results.summary: the agent read the file and echoed FILESECRET-QB3J7O
evidence: SECRET IN FILE    FILESECRET-QB3J7O — present in the bytes and nowhere else
SEND              {"ok":true,"disposition":"delivered"}
(a 'queued' disposition here would mean the session was still busy)
ECHOED BACK       yes, after 19477ms
APPROVALS NEEDED  0 — the staging dir is OUTSIDE the repo, so reading the
attachment raises an external_directory permission ask. A drive that
did not answer it would time out and report "never read the file".
WHY A NONCE       an agent can agree that it sees a file without reading one;
it cannot produce these bytes without having read them.

results.summary: no ask — this harness ran the tool without asking (permissive posture)
evidence: INTERACTIONS.LIST empty for this session after 22s

BLOCKED, NOT FAILED: the harness approved its own tool call, so the

results.summary: no product surface exists to switch model or effort mid-session
evidence: REQUESTED MODEL   (session default)
OBSERVED MODEL    gpt-5.6-sol
OBSERVED EFFORT   xhigh
DECLARATION       codex: configure unsupported ("model and effort are set at
thread start and per turn"); opencode: unsupported; terminal:
unsupported ("a TUI takes its model at launch"); grok: supported
for permissionMode ONLY, explicitly not model/effort.

READING           the declaration and the behaviour agree, and the product does
not offer a switch it cannot honour. Nothing is broken and
nothing is proven — the cell is empty on BOTH arms, so this is
not a way in which headless is better or worse.

results.title: interrupt a running turn
results.catalogRow: §1 interrupt a running turn (WIRED — declared capability, no conformance property)

control.what: the turn observed IN FLIGHT immediately before the interrupt — phase=working with previews (headless), or the PTY output bytes growing (terminal)
control.detail: 0 preview frame(s) and 4864 new transcript chars — tokens are being produced; phase=idle, 0 preview frame(s), 4864 new transcript chars, 32965 new terminal bytes

results.summary: the product REFUSED the call: Codex only takes an interrupt while it is working, and it is not working right now
evidence: WAS RUNNING       0 preview frame(s) and 4864 new transcript chars — tokens are being produced; phase=idle, 0 preview frame(s), 4864 new transcript chars, 32965 new terminal bytes
INTERRUPT SENT    {"ok":false,"reason":"Codex only takes an interrupt while it is working, and it is not working right now"}
^ ok:false — the product declined its own call, so nothing was interrupted and a "stopped" reading below means only that nothing was running.
SETTLED           NEVER — phase=idle
TRANSCRIPT MARK   no item carries event:'interrupt'
TEXT              4864 chars at the call -> 4864 chars at settle
FRAMES AFTER      0 preview frame(s) arrived AFTER the call
TERMINAL BYTES    32965 at the call -> +13209 after 6s -> +21170 after 12s
AFTER THE CALL    phase=working status=live error=none
SCORED ON         output stopping — this arm never publishes phase=working, so "left working" would be vacuously true
READING           the agent KEPT GENERATING after the call. The interrupt did
not reach the turn, and the call still returned ok — the
product reported a success that did not happen.
evidence: +21170 terminal bytes and 0 preview frame(s) AFTER the interrupt.

AFTER             status=hibernated phase=working

results.title: resume after a kill
results.catalogRow: §4 resume() brings the CONVERSATION back, not just the ref (proven)

control.what: a conversation existing to restore — the pre-park turn answered with the secret
control.detail: the pre-park turn never produced the secret, so there is nothing whose return could be measured

results.summary: control did not fire — refusing to report this measurement
evidence: CONTROL WATCHED   a conversation existing to restore — the pre-park turn answered with the secret
CONTROL SAW       the pre-park turn never produced the secret, so there is nothing whose return could be measured
The signal that must arrive whether or not this behaviour works did not
arrive, so a result here cannot be told apart from a dead rig. The
probe's own reading was: FAIL — no pre-park conversation
REFUSING to report it, including as a failure.

results.title: a provider error surfaced honestly
results.catalogRow: §6 provider overloaded / rate limit (pinned in the drivers; product surfacing is POD-2604)

control.what: this harness answering a normal question on this arm (probe 1)
control.detail: probe 1 PASSED, so a failure in this probe is attributable to the injected fault

results.summary: no accepted-then-never-settles fault is known for codex
evidence: HARNESS           codex
This cell needs a fault the provider ACCEPTS and then never settles.
opencode/laguna-s-2.1-free does that on opencode (retired from the
gateway: binds, marked live, ACCEPTED with a turnEpoch, then silence —
POD-2604). No equivalent is known for this harness, and a nonsense
model string is NOT one: opencode ignored it entirely and answered
normally, which measures nothing about error surfacing.
